sensitivity_block.policy_variant: cache-enabled: 40% of T2 input at 10% of input price

rounding.notes: Applied at publication only; all intermediate arithmetic is full-precision decimal. basket_cost carries more decimal places than dated_siu so the published print is reproducible from its own published figures. siu_per_usd truncates so it never overstates the work a dollar buys.

correction_notes.note: This print was published (2026-09-13, automated daily run) before two real bugs in this project's own code were fixed (commit 48ba69c), both affecting its own cost_of_production_usd. (1) RunRecord.usage.cached_input was captured by every provider adapter but never priced by this project's cost formula -- a real, unconditional gap, not specific to any one provider. For this print specifically: gemini-3.1-pro-preview: 84506 cached tokens, $0.016901; grok-4.6: 7296 cached tokens, $0.000004 -- together understating the published cost_of_production_usd ($1.3186) by $0.016905. This is not a hypothetical cache-adoption policy (see docs/methodology.md's sensitivity block, cachePolicyVariant, which is unrelated) -- this cache use actually happened and was actually billed. (2) Separately, and larger for gemini-3.1-pro-preview specifically: the Google adapter discarded a real, separately-billed API call's usage whenever Gemini's mandatory reasoning consumed the whole completion budget and triggered an internal retry with a bigger one -- only the retry's usage was recorded, not the first, truncated call's. This fires on nearly every gemini-3.1-pro-preview call. Its real input-token count and full raw response were never saved for this print's own run records (captured only after the fix), so this piece cannot be reconstructed precisely, unlike (1) above. Neither bug is corrected on this print's own signed cost_of_production_usd or dated_siu -- a published print's signed body is never edited -- so this print remains status: "provisional" permanently. See docs/methodology.md's Index governance for the full explanation.

dated_siu previously rounded to a fixed 4 decimal places rather than 4 significant figures — found live and fixed the same day, 2026-09-25 (docs/methodology.md's Rounding section). At this print's price level that was too coarse to show real day-to-day movement. This print's signed body is never edited — the published figure (0.0138) stands. Recomputed from this print's own published basket_costs and weights (Σ weight × basket_cost, rounded under the corrected 4-significant-figure rule, reproducible by anyone from this print's own published figures alone), the real value is 0.01381.
